mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, assemble_config_id, process, statistics_mode, measurement_manner
mapper.select: SELECT mgwc.*, sac.name AS assemble_config_name, mbp.id AS process_id, mbp.name AS process_name, sas.spec_prefix AS assemble_spec_prefix FROM mes_group_welding_config mgwc LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config sac ON sac.id = mgwc.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_spec sas ON sas.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND sas.assemble_config_id = mgwc.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON FIND_IN_SET(mbp.id, mgwc.process) > 0 WHERE mgwc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
SELECT count(0) FROM mes_group_welding_config WHERE bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT mgwc.*, sac.name AS assemble_config_name, mbp.id AS process_id, mbp.name AS process_name, sas.spec_prefix AS assemble_spec_prefix FROM mes_group_welding_config mgwc LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config sac ON sac.id = mgwc.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_spec sas ON sas.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND sas.assemble_config_id = mgwc.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON FIND_IN_SET(mbp.id, mgwc.process) > 0 WHERE mgwc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mgwc.id = #{id}
